name: io.github.youthmy11-ai/forgesuite-mcp
title: ForgeSuite Offline DevSecOps & Crypto FinOps MCP Server
description: Zero-dependency Node.js stdio MCP server: .env secret leak scanner, EVM calldata/risk decoder, LLM token cost calculator, and Solana Pay USDC / BEP20 / TRC20 invoice URI generator.

tools.name: envshield_scan
tools.description: Scan .env, JSON, YAML, or code snippets offline for leaked API keys, private keys, mnemonics, JWTs, and webhook secrets.

tools.name: calldata_decode
tools.description: Decode raw hexadecimal EVM transaction calldata (ERC-20, Permit2, Uniswap, Multisend) and flag unlimited approvals.

tools.name: tokencost_estimate
tools.description: Calculate per-call and monthly LLM/agent token spend across frontier models with prompt-caching discounts.

tools.name: cryptobill_quote
tools.description: Generate deterministic self-custody crypto invoice links and Solana Pay SPL-USDC / EIP-681 BEP20 / TRON payment URIs.
